source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:

   1. Direct staff to prepare a bylaw to amend the zoning designation of the property located at 592
       Phelps Avenue from R2 (One- and Two-Family Residential) to RS1 (Residential Small Lot 1), subject
       to the following terms and conditions:

            a)   That the owner agrees to provide, as a bonus for increased density, the following
                 contributions per new lot created, prior to subdivision approval:
                   i.    $3,960 towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund;
                         $660 towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund;

            b) That the applicant provides, prior to Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered
               in priority of all other charges on title, that agrees to the following:
                   i.   That an advisory note be written to provide future owners with the
                        understanding and that Western Speedway is located within a kilometer and may
                        generate a noise nuisance;
                  ii    That full frontage improvements be completed as per the Subdivision and
                        Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000 as a condition of subdivision approval, to
                        the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering; and
                 iii.   That all required measures recommended by the Stormwater Management Plan,
                        which may include the registration of a statutory right of way, shall be
                        implemented by the owner as a condition of Subdivision approval, to the
                        satisfaction of the Director of Engineering.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:

   1.   Direct staff to prepare a bylaw to amend the zoning designation of the property located at 2768
        and 2762 Claude Rd from R1 (One-Family Residential) to MU2 (Mixed-Use Residential
        Commercial) subject to the following terms and conditions:

                                                                          Regular Council Agenda — March 6th, 2017
                                                                                                      Page 3 of 12



              a.   That the following contributions are included in the bylaw as an amenity for increased
                   density, to be payable at the time of building permit:
                      i.   $1,525 per unit towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund; and
                     ii.   $610 per unit towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund.


              b. Notwithstanding 1. a, if the project is secured as rental housing, the following
                  contributions are included in the bylaw as an amenity for increased density, to be
                  payable at the time of building permit:
                     i.  $381.25 per unit towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund; and
                    ii.  $152.50 per unit towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund.

             c.    That the applicant provide the following items prior to Public Hearing:
                     i.    A road dedication plan;


             d. That the applicant provide the road dedication to the City prior to bylaw adoption.


             e. That the applicant register a Section 219 covenant, prior to bylaw adoption, that
                 includes the following:
                     i.  The owner pay for and construct all works to restrict left turn movements
                         southbound on Claude Road to Goldstream Avenue prior to issuance of
                         Occupancy Permit;
                    ii.  The owner provide a traffic and public safety plan and construction parking
                         management plan, prior to any onsite works and/or clearing, to the
                         satisfaction of the Director of Engineering;
                   iii.  The applicant shall construct frontage improvements, works and services to
                         the standards of Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000 and
                         to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering; and
                   iv.   The owner will register on title a Section 219 covenant for stormwater
                         maintenance prior to the request for Occupancy Permit as a condition of
                         rezoning.

2.   Direct the Director of Planning to apply the Bear Mountain and Westhills design guidelines for tall
     buildings to the subject development.

3.   Direct staff to amend the Multi-Family Design Guidelines to include design guidelines for tall
     buildings.


4.   Direct staff to amend the M U2 zone to increase the Floor Space Ration from 4 to 5.


5.   Direct the Director of Planning to issue the variance to reduce the front yard setback from 1.2m
     to Om in the time of Development Permit, for a portion of the building and generally in accordance
     with the plans attached.


6.   Direct the Director of Planning to issue the parking variance in the Development Permit subject
     to the applicant paying the City $5,000 for the one deficient stall prior to issuance of a building
     permit.

                                                                            Regular Council Agenda — March 6th, 2017
                                                                                                       Page 4 of 12

                            ii.   $610 per unit towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund.


                b. Notwithstanding 1. a, if the project is secured as rental housing, the following
                    contributions are included in the bylaw as an amenity for increased density, to be
                    payable at the time of building permit:
                           i.   $381.25 per unit towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund; and
                          ii.   $152.50 per unit towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund.

                c. That staff prepare a bylaw for the land exchange and that the applicant provide the
                    following items prior to First Reading:

                            development; and

                            building plans.

                                    plan, prior to any onsite works and/or clearing, to the satisfaction of the
                                    Director of Engineering;
                               ii.   Frontage improvements, works and services shall be completed to the
                                    standards of Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000;
                              iii.  The owner will register on title a Section 219 covenant for stormwater
                                     maintenance prior to the request for Occupancy Permit as a condition of
                                     rezoning; and
                             iv.    That the applicant provide a wayfinding sign at the trail junction to the
                                    satisfaction of the Parks Manager.

     2.   Direct the Director of Planning to issue the variance to reduce the exterior side yard setback from
          1.2m to 0.6m at the time of Development Permit.


     3.   Direct the Director of Planning to issue the parking variance in the Development Permit.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:

1.   Give First Reading to Bylaw No. 1673 to amend the zoning designation of the property located at 616
     Goldstream Ave from RM2 to RM7A, subject to the following terms and conditions:

             a) That the applicant provides, prior to Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered
                 in priority of all other charges on title, that agrees to the following:

                     i.     That a stormwater maintenance covenant be registered on title prior to the request
                            for Occupancy Permit as a condition of rezoning;
                    ii.     That the owner provide a construction parking management plan to the satisfaction
                            of the Director of Engineering prior to the commencement of any works on-site;
                    iii.    That the owner will provide a new queue length assessment from a traffic engineer
                            to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior to the issuance of a Building
                            Permit for Building 2;

                                                                            Regular Council Agenda — March 6th, 2017
                                                                                                       Page 6 of 12



   2.   Provide a permissive tax exemption, on land and improvements, subject to a covenant being
        registered on title that the proposed residential units will be non-profit affordable housing rental
        units for at least 10 years;

   3.   Authorize the Director of Planning to issue a variance to the required off-street parking for
        Building 1 with a condition that the amount of parking provided for Building 1 be reassessed prior
        to the commencement of Phase 2, and that additional parking spaces be allocated to users of
        Building 1 if the amount of parking is deemed insufficient at that time;


   4.   Direct staff to proceed with the proposed design of Building 1 through the development permit
        process.

   5.   Waive all required amenity contributions and application fees charged by the City of Langford to
        allow the 160-unit subsidized affordable housing rental development proposed in this application
        subject to the owner registering a Section 219 Covenant requiring the new residential units will
        be subsidized non-profit affordable housing rental units for at least 10 years AND direct staff to
        amend the Amenity Contribution Policy and any necessary development application fee bylaws
        to waive the required amenity contributions and application fees for any subsequent subsidized
        affordable housing rental development.
